translation.name: Biblica® Bayibuli Entukuvu, Endagaano Enkadde nʼEndagaano Empya ekwatiddwa ku katambi™

content.text: n’ensi ke katebe kwe mpummuliza ebigere byange,
Ebintu bino byonna emikono gyange si gye gyagikola,
oyo ow’eggonjebwa era omwetoowaze mu mwoyo,
Naye asaddaaka ente aba ng’asse omuntu,
oyo awaayo omwana gw’endiga n’aba ng’amenye ensingo y’embwa,
era emmeeme zaabwe zisanyukira eby’emizizo byabwe.
era ababayigganya olw’erinnya lyange babasekerera nti,
Oluyoogaano oluva mu kibuga, muwulirize eddoboozi eriva mu yeekaalu.
Eddoboozi eryo lya Mukama Katonda ng’asasula abalabe be
Ani eyali awulidde ekintu bwe kityo?
Ensi eyinza okuzaalibwa mu lunaku lumu
oba eggwanga okutondebwawo mu kaseera obuseera?
Nnyinza okutuusa abantu bange ku kuzaalibwa
nga ndutuusizza ku kuzaala?” bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda wo.

content: Kubanga bw’ati bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda nti,

content.text: obugagga bw’amawanga bube gye muli ng’omugga ogwanjaala.
era kirikufuula w’amaanyi omulamu obulungi ng’omuddo ogukuze.
Olwo kiryoke kimanyibwe nti omukono gwa Mukama Katonda guyamba abaweereza be,
ate obusungu bwe ne bulagibwa abalabe be.
“Kubanga laba Mukama Katonda alijjira mu muliro,
era n’amagaali ge ag’embalaasi galiba ng’empewo ey’omuyaga.

content: “Abo abeetukuza balyoke balage mu nnimiro entukuvu okukola eby’emizizo, abatambulira mu nnyiriri nga bwe balya embizzi, omusonso n’emmere ey’omuzizo, bonna balizikirira wamu,” bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda.
“Olw’ebyo bye bakola ne bye balowooza, nnaatera okujja nkuŋŋaanye amawanga gonna n’ennimi zonna, era balijja balabe ekitiibwa kyange.
“Nditeeka akabonero mu bo. Ndiwonyaako abamu mbasindike mu mawanga, e Talusiisi, e Puuli
, n’e Luudi, abaleega omutego, eri Tubali ne Yavani,
mu bizinga eby’ewala, abatawuliranga ttutumu lyange, wadde okulaba ekitiibwa kyange.

Balikomyawo baganda bammwe bonna okuva mu mawanga nga ekirabo gye ndi. Balibaleetera ku mbalaasi, ne mu magaali ge mbalaasi n’ebigaali ne ku nnyumbu n’eŋŋamira ku lusozi lwange olutukuvu nga Isirayiri bwe baleeta ebiweebwayo ebirongoofu mu nnyumba ya Mukama Katonda.
Era ndifuula abamu ku bo okubeera bakabona n’abaleevi,” bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda.
“Kubanga nga eggulu eppya n’ensi empya, bye ndikola bwe biribeerawo olw’amaanyi gange, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda, bwe lityo ezzadde lyammwe n’erinnya lyammwe bwe birisigala.
Okuva ku mwezi okutuuka ku mwezi, n’okuva ku ssabbiiti okutuuka ku ssabbiiti, bonna abalina omubiri banajjanga okusinziza mu maaso gange,” bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda.
“Kale bwe baliba bafuluma, baliraba emirambo gy’abasajja abanneewaggulako; kubanga envunyu zaabwe tezirifa, so n’omuliro gwabwe tegulizikizibwa; era baliba kyennyinnyalwa eri abantu bonna.”

footnotes.text: Puuli ne Puuti bye bimu. Puuti ye Libiya oba ekitundu ekyetoolodde n’okutuukira ddala ku Somaliya
